_comment: The 'second' Milo on the little island in the Village (pale_world.py, link 'milo'). There from the very first second, reachable only through the Pale World. The ONE fourth-wall break in the game (heavy irony, like Fredbear in FNaF World's Halloween update). Scary voice = black screen + silence. A placeholder for something later - for now only this talk.

lines.text: Oh. Look at that. You found the stone.
Congratulations. I've been standing on this little island since the very first second of the game.
Watching you walk in circles. Losing to slimes. Paying a man in a hood for a pistol.
Yes, I'm also standing by the fence. Don't think about it too hard. Nobody else does.
This? This is content. Very mysterious, very deep lore. Glitching through walls with a glowing marble. Truly the peak of game design.
You were hoping for a reward. A secret boss. An ending, maybe.
There's nothing here yet. Somebody still has to make it mean something. Somebody is very busy.
So go on. Back through your little stone. Tell everyone you found the island. They'll be thrilled.
Still not finished. Come back after an update.
You came all the way back here. For this. Incredible dedication.
